text:
ravi: Scheduling a wave-shifted maintenance for eu-west1 this Tuesday 02:30-04:30 UTC. Goal: GPU BIOS + NIC microcode to stop intermittent DMA errors. We'll do rolling mini-drains to limit KV cold-hits.

zoe: Thx. What's the expected usable GPU loss and which pools?

ravi: Expect ~5-9% usable capacity drop at peak. Affected pools: nebula-eu and loadstone. We've flagged three enterprise tenants in the runbook.

pat: Suggest we run 3-tier canaries: rack-level, ToR-level and a cross-rack pair. If all healthy, proceed with wave batches of 2 racks. That keeps kvcache warm-ish.

ravi: Agreed. Plan: canary1 (rack-4), canary2 (rack-21 disjoint ToR), cross-pair (rack-4 + rack-22). Wave batches: two racks per wave, ~9-11m per wave including kv-sprinkle.

ops-bot: maintenance ticket created (mw-7822). Reminder scheduled 45m before window.

zoe: Cost/egress: if we divert traffic to eu-central fallback for heavy routes for 2h, what's the egress delta? Need a number for finance.

pat: Current eu-west1 outbound ~850GB/h. If we shift 2h to eu-central at $0.095/GB -> 850GB * 2 * 0.095 = $161.5. Add 20% buffer for retries and double-serving -> ~$194.

finance-bot: Flag: please label cross-region flows with "maint=mw-7822" for attribution. Approve up to $250 for this window.

ravi: Runbook snippet:
```
02:00 UTC - preflight: telemetry sanity, reserve 10% slots, notify prod comms
02:30 - canary1 (rack-4): cordon -> evict noncritical -> soft-reboot -> smoke tests -> kv-sprinkle
02:45 - canary2 (rack-21) repeat
03:05 - cross-pair (rack-4 + rack-22) -> verify ToR isolation
03:20 - wave batches (2 racks / wave, 9-11m per wave)
04:20 - final sweep, de-cordon, postflight metrics
```

zoe: What's "kv-sprinkle"? :)

pat: informal: a small targeted kvcache seeding job to reduce cold-hit surface. We'll run a short job that replays warm prefixes.

ravi: Failure criteria: smoke test p99 > baseline *1.6 OR error rate >2% OR sustained TCP retrans > threshold. On failure: abort sequence, uncordon last wave, revert routing weights, trigger emergency kv-sprinkle, page infra lead.

pat: Autoscaler tweak: set kube-autoscaler max-surge +6% and increase scale-up aggressiveness for 20m after each wave. Helps soak soft-evac.

zoe: Networking note: rack-21 has a ToR firmware mismatch (older). That's why it's a canary. If we see asymmetric packet loss between canaries, abort and isolate the ToR.

ravi: I'll add a temporary routing override for routes with slo>=99.95 to prefer eu-central during the most aggressive waves. We'll revoke it after the window.

finance-bot: Also capture estimated egress in the ticket and tag spend. If we exceed $250, auto-alert finance for approval.

pat: Smoke scripts posted for visibility:
```bash
# simple smoke: embeddings + gen
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/model/embeddings -d '{"prompt":"health"}' | jq '.latency, .status'
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/model/gen -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq '.tokens, .latency'
```

zoe: I'll coordinate tenant notices and a small UI banner for eu-west1 users. Ravi, please add runbook link.

ravi: Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/eu/wave-mw-7822 (preflight checklist there). Added labels and telemetry tags as requested.

ops-bot: 15m preflight reminder will post to #oncall and flagged tenant channels.

pat: Minor ask: add a quick metric in the runbook to capture kv-hit-ratio delta during each wave so we can quantify impact.

ravi: done. Team owners: canaries -> pat, waves -> zoe, comms -> zoe. Opening calendar invite now. Ping here for any last-minute risks. :white_check_mark:
